title: Token emission micro-tracing and prefetch/KV-hit attribution pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add low-overhead, privacy-preserving per-token micro-tracing hooks and an aggregation pipeline to quantify the latency and cost impact of token emission and KV cache behavior. Instrumentation will emit lightweight OpenTelemetry spans on emission hot-paths (not full token payloads), tag KV cache hits/prefetches, and publish sampled events to the observability pipeline for aggregation into model/route dashboards and cost reconciliation. This work spans runtime change (hooks), ingestion (Kafka topic + schema), streaming aggregation job, and Grafana dashboards. Focus: minimize CPU/latency impact; avoid logging raw tokens; enable downsampled retention for long tail analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits nested token-emission spans (OTel) with attributes: token_index, token_hash, kv_cache_hit, prefetch_ms, kernel_exec_ms, batch_size, model, route_id. No raw token text is emitted.
Span emission is gated by sampling config and per-request budget; default sampling targets <0.5% of requests and <1% p99 latency overhead on standard 128-token generations.
Ingestion pipeline accepts the token spans into topic 'observability.tokens.v1' with JSON schema and schema registry entry.

Streaming aggregation job computes per-model and per-route metrics: per-token median and p95 latency, KV-hit delta (avg latency with hit vs miss), token cost delta, and exports to ClickHouse / metrics store every minute.
Grafana dashboard 'Token Emission: KV Impact' created with panels for per-model KV hit rate, KV-hit latency delta, tokens/sec, and sample waterline traces; accessible in Console > Observability.
Automated reconciliation job runs daily to compare aggregated token-level cost against billed usage and flags >2% variance for investigation.
Feature flagged rollout enabled; can be toggled per-cluster and per-customer; default off for Private deployments until security review.
Unit and integration tests for runtime hook, schema validation, and aggregation job are added and passing in CI.

notes: This ticket intentionally avoids emitting raw token text. We will use salted hashing (HMAC-SHA256) of token byte sequence with rotating salt to allow duplicate detection without storing PII. Retention policy: sampled token spans retained for 30 days; aggregates retained for 2 years.
